definitions: Having a smooth, even surface; not curved or bumpy.
Relatively low in height or depth; not steep or deep.
Lacking in interest or variety; dull or uninspired.
Having a lower pitch or tone than is correct or intended (in music).
examples: The road was flat and easy to cycle on.
The land was flat for miles around.
The performance was a bit flat.
The singer hit a flat note.
